result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVParserAgentTest.java` with 32 JUnit 4 tests covering `CSVParser`: happy-path parsing, header maps (including copy semantics, null when absent, duplicate-name errors), record/line numbering, comments, null-string mapping, trimming, iterator edge cases (close, exhaustion, remove unsupported), malformed-quote IOException, null-argument `IllegalArgumentException`s for all factory/constructor overloads, file-based parsing, and empty/no-trailing-newline input. All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
